newsitem.title: USA: IVC completes HealthRite unit buy.
newsitem.headline: IVC completes HealthRite unit buy.

text.p: IVC Industries Inc said Monday it completed its acquisition of HealthRite Inc's Vitamin Specialties division for $2.7 million in cash.

The acquisition will be accounted for as a purchase, said Alan Hirschfeld, an IVC executive vice president. From today on, Vitamin's revenues will be included in IVC's fourth quarter and fiscal year-end results ending July 31, he added.

Hirschfeld estimated Vitamin's existing stores to contribute $4 million to $5 million in annual sales. He added he projected "significantly higher" net income for the year ending July 31 than the $296,000 IVC posted the year before.
